claims.statement: For every real matrix B and every k, there are k-color partitions of its original row and column indices and a permutation sigma such that the product over a of ||B[L_a,R_sigma(a)]||_F^2 is at least e_k(BB^T)/k^(2k); simultaneously the rainbow k-minor mass is at least (k!/k^k)^2 e_k(BB^T).
In the completed O0 branch with e_3(BB^T)>=1/256, six original-coordinate banks can be chosen so three disjoint matching cross blocks have squared-Frobenius product at least 1/186624.
Applying fleet02/B19 r17 S0, e_2(BB^T)>=1/48 implies four original-coordinate banks and a matching with product of two cross-block squared Frobenius norms at least 1/768.

Convert the new two-/three-matching bank currencies into a dimension-free half-Riesz or density payment with arbitrary self blocks and extra spectrum, or descend to an already-paid branch, without selecting a reciprocal tiny minor.
